items.source:
Central abstraction for MongoDB collation support.
Allows fluent creation of a collation Document that can be used for creating collections and indexes as well as querying data.
NOTE: Please keep in mind that queries will only make use of an index with collation settings if the query itself specifies the same collation.
items.translation:
MongoDB 排序规则支持的中央抽象。
允许以流畅的方式创建可用于创建集合和索引以及查询数据的排序规则 Document。
注意： 请记住，仅当查询本身指定了相同的排序规则时，才会使用具有排序规则设置的索引。
